signature: SUBROUTINE ZRSCL( N, A, X, INCX )

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of components of the vector x.

params.name: a
params.reference: The scalar a which is used to divide each component of x. A must not be 0, or the subroutine will divide by zero.

params.name: incx
params.reference:
The increment between successive values of the vector SX.

-   `> 0`: $\mathrm{SX}(1) = X(1)$ and $\mathrm{SX}(1+(i-1) \, \mathrm{INCX}) = x(i)$,     $1< i \le n$
